forms.title: Pakistan Hajj 2027 Application Form (Government Scheme)
forms.description: The official Pakistan Government Hajj Scheme application form for Hajj 1448H / 2027. Issued by the Ministry of Religious Affairs and Inter-faith Harmony (MoRA). Required for the November–December 2026 application window, with lottery (Qura) results announced in December 2026. The form requires CNIC details, passport details, banking information, vaccination records, and (for women under 45) Mahram details with nikah-nama or birth-certificate proof of relationship.

forms.title: Umrah Booking Checklist for Pakistani Pilgrims
forms.description: Comprehensive pre-booking checklist for Pakistani pilgrims planning Umrah. Covers passport validity (6 months minimum), polio vaccination booster (mandatory for all Pakistani travellers, valid 28 days to 12 months before arrival), meningococcal ACWY vaccination, Saudi Umrah visa documents, hotel proximity requirements (within 400m of Haram recommended), airline baggage rules (30 kg + 7 kg on PIA, Saudia, Air Sial), and pre-departure briefing items. Use this before signing any Umrah package contract.

forms.title: Mahram Affidavit Template (Hajj/Umrah for Women)
forms.description: Affidavit template for Pakistani women under 45 travelling to Saudi Arabia for Hajj or Umrah with a Mahram. Documents the relationship (father, brother, husband, or son), travel dates, and joint accommodation. Required by the Pakistan Government Hajj Scheme and many private Hajj Group Operators. Should be printed on Rs. 50 stamp paper, signed by both parties, and notarised by an Oath Commissioner. Saudi authorities allow women aged 45+ to travel for Hajj without Mahram in supervised groups since 2021.

forms.title: Polio Vaccination Yellow Card (Pakistan → Saudi Arabia)
forms.description: Information sheet explaining the mandatory polio vaccination booster for all Pakistani travellers to Saudi Arabia. The booster is free at any government EPI (Expanded Programme on Immunization) centre in Pakistan and must be administered between 28 days and 12 months before arrival in Saudi. The yellow vaccination card is checked at Jeddah and Madinah immigration. Major EPI centres in Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Peshawar, and Quetta are listed.
forms.source: Al Bari Travel & Tours / EPI Pakistan

forms.title: Printable Umrah Packing Checklist (One-Page)
forms.description: A printable one-page Umrah packing checklist covering documents (passport, e-visa, vaccination card, hotel vouchers), Ihram and clothing (2 sets Ihram for men, abayas for women, prayer shoes), toiletries (unscented for Ihram), medicines, electronics, money, and Madinah-specific extras. Built from what our group leaders carry on every departure — pin to the fridge, tick off as you pack.

forms.title: Saudi Umrah Visa Document Checklist (Pakistan)
forms.description: Complete document checklist for the Saudi Umrah visa application from Pakistan — covering both the traditional MoFA route (via licensed Pakistani agent) and the Nusuk Masar e-Visa route (direct self-application). Includes the eight required documents: machine-readable passport with 6 months validity, two passport-size photographs, polio + meningococcal vaccination cards, confirmed hotel booking, confirmed return ticket, CNIC, and bank-statement evidence (for Nusuk Masar).

forms.title: Saudi Document Attestation Flowchart (HEC → MoFA → Embassy)
forms.description: Visual flowchart showing the three-stage Pakistani document attestation chain required for Saudi work visas, student visas, and family residence visas: Stage 1 (originating authority — HEC for degrees, NADRA for marriage/birth certificates, District Police for PCC), Stage 2 (MoFA Camp Office), Stage 3 (Saudi Embassy Islamabad or Consulate Karachi). Each stage shows fees, processing time, required documents, and common rejection reasons.

forms.title: GAMCA Medical Centres in Pakistan — Full List
forms.description: Complete city-by-city list of GAMCA-approved (now Wafid-administered) medical centres in Pakistan for Gulf work visa applicants. Covers Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Quetta, Multan, Faisalabad, Sukkur, and Sialkot. Includes the standard panel of tests (HIV, Hep B/C, syphilis, chest X-ray, drug screen, pregnancy test), 2026 fees (PKR 6,500–9,500), and report turnaround (2–4 working days).

forms.title: Schengen Visa Application Form (for Pakistani Applicants)
forms.description: Standard Schengen visa application form, harmonised across all 27 Schengen countries. Pakistani applicants apply through VFS Global (for France, Germany, Italy, Switzerland) or BLS International (for Spain) in Karachi, Lahore, or Islamabad. The form covers personal details, passport details, intended travel dates, accommodation, financial sponsor, and travel history. Must be filled in capital letters, signed, and submitted with all supporting documents.

forms.title: Schengen Cover Letter Template (Pakistani Applicants)
forms.description: Editable cover-letter template for Pakistani Schengen visa applicants. Frames your travel purpose, declares strong ties to Pakistan (employment, family, property, ongoing studies), confirms financial responsibility, provides a day-by-day itinerary outline, and confirms intent to return. Used by our agency for hundreds of successful Pakistani Schengen applications. Customise the highlighted sections with your specifics.

forms.title: UK Student Visa Document Checklist (Pakistan)
forms.description: Complete UK Student Visa (formerly Tier 4) document checklist for Pakistani applicants. Covers the CAS letter from your UK sponsor, the financial requirement (first-year tuition + GBP 17,796 London / GBP 13,632 outside London for 12 months, held for 28 consecutive days), IELTS or alternative SELT, IOM TB test (mandatory for Pakistanis at IOM Karachi/Lahore/Islamabad), polio vaccination, academic transcripts, and biometric appointment booking at VFS Karachi or Islamabad.

forms.title: UK Standard Visitor Visa Checklist (Pakistan)
forms.description: Document checklist for the UK Standard Visitor Visa for Pakistani applicants. Covers passport requirements, financial evidence (6 months of bank statements showing consistent income/savings), employment proof, accommodation booking, return-flight reservation, sponsor letter (if relying on a UK-based sponsor), proof of strong ties to Pakistan, and the GBP 127 visa fee. Submit at VFS Karachi, Lahore, or Islamabad after online application at gov.uk.

forms.title: POE Protector Stamp Application (Pakistan → Gulf Work)
forms.description: Information on the mandatory Protector of Emigrants (POE) stamp for every Pakistani going abroad on a work visa. Issued by the Bureau of Emigration and Overseas Employment (BEMB) at one of 8 POE offices (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Multan, Rawalpindi, Peshawar, Quetta, Faisalabad). Without the stamp, Pakistani immigration will block you from boarding the flight. Fee: PKR 1,000. Validity: 60 days from issuance.
forms.source: Bureau of Emigration & Overseas Employment, Pakistan

forms.title: Gulf Work Visa Document Checklist (Pakistan)
forms.description: Master document checklist for any Gulf country work visa from Pakistan — Saudi, UAE, Qatar, Bahrain, Oman, Kuwait. Covers the demand letter / offer letter, three-stage attested documents (educational degrees via HEC + MoFA + Embassy; PCC; marriage and birth certificates if going with family), GAMCA medical certificate, passport copy, photographs, POE Protector form, and country-specific extras (e.g. Tawjeeh for UAE, Hayya for Qatar).

forms.title: Pakistan Passport Renewal Form (MRP / e-Passport)
forms.description: Information and application procedure for Pakistan Machine-Readable Passport (MRP) and e-Passport renewal. Apply online at dgip.gov.pk, book an appointment at any DGI&P Passport Office in Pakistan, pay the bank challan, attend biometric capture, and collect on the scheduled date. 2026 fees: MRP 5-year PKR 4,500 (normal) / PKR 9,000 (fee priority). e-Passport approximately double.
forms.source: Directorate General of Immigration & Passports, Pakistan

forms.title: NADRA Computerised Marriage Certificate Application
forms.description: Application procedure for the NADRA computerised marriage certificate, required for Saudi family visit/residence visas, UK spouse visas, US K-1 visas, and most international family applications. Apply at any NADRA Mega Centre with original Nikah-nama, both spouses' CNIC, and two witnesses' CNIC. Processing: 7–14 working days. Fee: PKR 250–500. The original Nikah-nama from your Nikah Registrar is not directly accepted by most foreign embassies — use the NADRA version.

forms.title: Al Bari Umrah Quotation Request Form
forms.description: Use this form to request a customised Umrah quotation from Al Bari Travel & Tours. Tell us your preferred departure city, intended travel dates (avoid Hajj-season blackout May–July if possible), number of pilgrims with ages, hotel preference (3-star economy / 4-star standard / 5-star premium), proximity to Haram preference, and any special requirements (wheelchair, dietary, mahram structure). We respond within 4 hours during Pakistan business hours.

forms.title: Al Bari Group Booking Form (Mosque & Community Groups)
forms.description: Group booking form for mosques, community organisations, family groups, and corporate Umrah parties of 10+ pilgrims. We offer dedicated group leaders, separated accommodation blocks, customised meal plans, group ziyarat tours, and private pre-departure briefings at your mosque or community centre. Per-pilgrim rates fall significantly with group size. Form collects group size, preferred dates, hotel tier preference, and group leader contact.
